Ahaziah son of Jehoram, king of Judah, reigned only one year before Jehu killed him at the ascent of Gur during the bloody purge of Ahab's house (2 Kgs 9:27-28). The LXX renders both as Ochozias, and the Spanish 'Ocozias' and French 'Achazia' follow suit. A third bearer, the priest Achzai (Neh 11:13), carries a shortened form of the same name."
